categories.name: Resolve via timely payment
categories.description: Resolution of the fine case through early payment by the offender. Advances the 'Maximize timely fine revenue' softgoal and helps 'Minimize administrative & enforcement cost'. Measured against indicator 'Time to fine dispatch (days)' and 'Average time to case closure (days)'.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to declared alternative task 12 as observed in frequent variants such as V0002.

categories.name: Resolve via delinquent payment
categories.description: Resolution of the fine case through payment after notifications and penalties have been applied. Helps 'Maximize timely fine revenue'. Measured against indicator 'Average time to case closure (days)'.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to declared alternative task 13 as seen in variants where payment occurs after penalty addition such as V0004 and V0006.

categories.name: Resolve via administrative appeal to the Prefecture
categories.description: Resolution path involving administrative appeal to the Prefecture. Preserves offender's due-process rights while impacting enforcement costs and revenue. Measured against indicator 'Time to appeal filing, Prefecture (days)'.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to declared alternative task 14 representing administrative appeals observed in variants like V0008 and V0057.

categories.name: Resolve via judicial appeal to the Judge
categories.description: Resolution path involving judicial appeal to the Judge. Strongly preserves due-process rights but hurts enforcement cost and revenue. Measured against indicator 'Time to appeal filing, Judge (days)'.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to declared alternative task 19 representing judicial appeals found in variants like V0103 and V0140.

categories.name: Resolve via coercive credit collection
categories.description: Resolution path via coercive credit collection for unpaid or unresolved fines. Helps revenue but hurts cost and due-process softgoals. Measured against indicator 'Average time to case closure (days)'.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to declared alternative task 20 representing credit collection endpoints observed in high-duration variants like V0001 and V0009.
